executable_rules.rule: Observations sharing one dedup_group (COVERAGE_EVIDENCE_MAP class, e.g. S08 for Transparent/Semi Transparent/Mesh) are ONE pathway.
executable_rules.authority: Dedup Contract dedup_groups · Semantic Status dedup_key

executable_rules.rule: Mesh co-observed with Semi Transparent / Transparent is ABSORBED into S08 and never a second force.

Pleated co-observed with Semi Transparent / Transparent on the same target is the SAME physical pathway by default (K08). Independence requires evidence of a structurally separate realization — the current input does not carry that evidence, so the default holds.
executable_rules.authority: Dedup Contract K08 pair (Semi Transparent ↔ Pleated)

executable_rules.rule: pattern=Linear co-observed with Semi Transparent / Transparent is ABSORBED when the linear reading has no pattern-bound contrast carrier (K08: the pleat structure produces the lines). A contrasting pattern-bound carrier (K13: white@pattern:Linear) makes Linear a genuinely independent stripe.
Sequin-Beading co-observed with Reflective is ONE pathway (the reflectivity IS the embellishment).
A Colour V1 carrier colour attributed to an evidence is that evidence's realization detail, never a second pathway.
Two surviving groups are independent when they are different physical/design phenomena (e.g. Appliqué vs ground-cloth texture — K06). Parameter count is never pathway count.
Weak pathways, however many and however independent, never aggregate.
